details.title: Jacques le fataliste et son maître
details.author: Denis Diderot

reading.review:
Playful, self-aware, and centuries ahead of its time. Diderot constantly interrupts his own story to banter with the reader about narrative conventions, chance, and free will while Jacques and his master meander along unnamed roads.

A delightful reminder that experimental fiction did not begin in the twentieth century.

note.note-text: The narrator teasingly refuses to tell us where Jacques and his master came from or where they are going.
